systems.country_label: recensement scolaire; annuaire statistique; plateforme StatEduc2
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education (MEN/A/PL), Direction des Statistiques (DSP/TICE), with technical support from INS
systems.tiers: printed questionnaires filled by heads of pre-primary, primary and secondary establishments (April 2025), sent up and corrected at regional level (May), keyed in the regional directorates from June 2025, regional databases consolidated centrally (July-August); primary coverage 17,904 of 18,282 establishments (97.9%)

note: The method chapter describes only the yearly paper questionnaire keyed into StatEduc2 at regional level: a census, so no fact. It says nothing of how schools keep learner records. Examination results come from the examination services, not from schools. The capture is truncated in the regional tables.
